About.title: About me
About.content:
I’m a digital product developer and UI/UX designer, and I help brands and businesses turn ideas into solid digital products — from strategy and design to full-stack development. 

 I care about every detail: user experience, performance, technical architecture, and the small interactions that make a product feel reliable and professional. 

 I work closely with every client, understanding their business goals to deliver solutions that don't just look good, but actually work and drive real results. 

 If you're looking for a partner who combines design vision, technical depth, and real commitment to your project, I'm here to help you build it.

Cookies.title: Your privacy matters
Cookies.text: I use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to understand how the site is used and to improve it. They stay off until you accept.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: Juan Tapias is the controller of the data collected on this website. You can write to hola@juantapias.dev with any privacy question.

sections.title: What data I collect
sections.body: This site has no forms or user accounts. I only process the data you send me when you contact me by email or WhatsApp and, if you accept cookies, anonymous browsing data: page views, link clicks, device type, browser, approximate country and language.

sections.title: Cookies I use
sections.body: Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC) sets the _ga and _ga_* cookies, lasting up to 2 years, to tell visits apart and measure site usage. Analytics storage stays denied until you click Accept. If you reject, no analytics cookies are set. The site also stores your choice in your browser's local storage (cookie-consent).

sections.title: How I use the data
sections.body: Only to measure and improve the site's performance and content, and to reply to the messages you send me. I do not sell data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: Third parties
sections.body: Google Analytics may transfer data to Google servers outside your country. Links to WhatsApp and social networks lead to third-party services with their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, update, correct or request deletion of your data, and withdraw your consent at any time (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and, where applicable, the GDPR). To exercise them, email hola@juantapias.dev.

sections.title: Changing your choice
sections.body: You can change your cookie choice at any time using the "Cookies" link in the footer.
